column.name: summary
column.value: A tour of the Markdown features this blog supports.

insert.column:
Posts are written in **Markdown** and rendered to HTML when the page is shown.
## Text
You can use *emphasis*, **bold**, ~~strikethrough~~, and `inline code`. Plain URLs such as https://commonmark.org become links automatically, and so do [named links](https://spring.io).
> Blockquotes are useful for quoting documentation or other people.
## Lists
1. Ordered lists 2. are numbered - and can contain - nested lists
## Code
```java @GetMapping("/posts/{slug}") String post(@PathVariable String slug, Model model) { model.addAttribute("post", postService.findPublishedBySlug(slug)); return "post"; } ```
## Tables
| Feature | Syntax | |---------------|-----------------| | Bold | `**text**` | | Strikethrough | `~~text~~` | | Link | `[text](url)` |
## Safety
Raw HTML is shown as text instead of being run, so this is harmless: <script>alert('hi')</script>
